literature_notes: PRRG3 is a single-pass type I-like membrane protein with an extracellular N-terminal domain (residues 1–79), a single TM helix (80–100), and a long intracellular C-terminal tail (101–231). The sole ledger line (L1) reports a C-terminal myc-tagged PRRG3 construct expressed in mammalian cells. The C-terminus (residue 231, K) falls entirely within the intracellular span (101–231); this tag is therefore on the cytoplasmic face and does not qualify as a surface tag site. No ledger line reports any insertion — epitope tag, fluorescent protein, transposon, or domain insertion — at the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–79) or anywhere else on the extracellular face of PRRG3. Because the ledger provides no extracellular insertion evidence, zero sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal myc tag on full-length PRRG3 expressed in mammalian cells; residue 231 (K) lies within the intracellular span (101–231) and is therefore cytoplasmic, not a surface tag site.
